build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build:helper:release && npm run build

windows.label: main
windows.title: CC DiskSage — 磁盘空间管家

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://localhost:1420 ws://localhost:1421; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first Windows disk cleanup with an evidence chain
bundle.longDescription: CC DiskSage scans disk usage, proposes rule-verified cleanup candidates, and shows a local evidence chain for every item. An optional OpenAI-compatible LLM can annotate findings, but it can never delete files or invent paths, commands, or numbers.
